newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell merges Singapore units.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell merges Singapore units.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said on Tuesday it had merged its two merchant banking units Deutsche Bank (Asia Pacific) Ltd (DBAP) and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell Singapore (DMGS).
The company said in a statement with effect from October 1, DMGS's assets and employees would be transferred to DBAP, which had been renamed Deutsche Morgan Grenfell (Singapore) Ltd.

"We have identified the need to rationalise our merchant banking activities both in Singapore and in the region," it quoted Hans Beck, the chief executive of Deutsche Morgan Grenfell's Asia Pacific region, as saying. He added the merger would achieve greater operational efficency.
In a separate statement, the company also announced the resignation of Lai Hock Meng, managing director of Deutsche Morgan Grenfell & Partners Securities, and Foo Fatt Kah, research director.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell is the investment banking arm of Deutsche Bank.
